title: Bug Killer Private Disclosure Packet v1 (PROPOSED)

packet_id.description: Unique identifier for the disclosure packet envelope.

finding_id.description: Reference to the source finding or research candidate finding_id.

lifecycle_state.description: Authoritative lifecycle state of the disclosure packet.

title.description: Clear descriptive summary of the discovered vulnerability.

vulnerability_type.description: Classification (e.g. Remote Code Execution, Memory Corruption, Authentication Bypass).

severity.description: Assessed severity level according to CVSS qualification.

package.description: Component or package name affected by the issue.

commit_range.description: Vulnerable commit hash range or release tag range.

repository.description: Canonical upstream repository URL or identifier.

source_snapshot_sha256.description: Cryptographic digest of the audited source tree snapshot.

prerequisites.description: Operational prerequisites or environmental conditions for exploitability.

attack_vector.description: Network, Adjacent, Local, or Physical context.

privileges_required.description: Privilege level required by the attacker (None, Low, High).

user_interaction.description: Whether benign user interaction is required (None, Required).

scope.description: Whether vulnerability impacts resources beyond its security authority (Unchanged, Changed).

test_type.description: Type of offline test harness (e.g. Unit Test, Property Invariant, Sanitizer Fixture).

harness_code.description: Deterministic, harmless offline reproduction harness code.

sanitized_input.description: Sanitized trigger input. MUST NOT contain weaponized shellcode, live credentials, or binary exploit payloads.

expected_behavior.description: Expected safe execution or rejection behavior.

observed_behavior.description: Observed failure, panic, or security assertion violation.

safe_reproduction.description: Safe offline reproduction steps and harness. MUST NOT contain weaponized shellcode, live attack payloads, or remote execution triggers.

summary.description: Technical analysis of the root cause in source logic.

trace_evidence_hashes.description: SHA-256 hashes of verifiable execution or taint traces.

diff.description: Suggested patch formatted as unified diff.

compatibility_notes.description: Evaluation of breaking changes, API impacts, or regression risks.

fixed_versions.description: Target release versions receiving the remediation.

channel_type.description: Upstream coordinated reporting channel (e.g. GitHubPrivateVulnerabilityReporting, SecurityEmail, SecurityTxt).

contact_target.description: Specific endpoint, security email address, or repository slug.

security_policy_url.description: Verified upstream security policy URL (e.g. from SECURITY.md).

credit_name.description: Name or pseudonym for security advisory attribution.

contact_email.description: Secure email address for maintainer coordination.

updated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of packet last modification.
